events.event: Former Trade Minister Muhammad Lutfi, in an Instagram post on @m.lutfi, attacks Singapore's warning letters to seven Indonesian firms over haze as a show for voters and says Singapore-based parents control the concessions and have never been prosecuted under its Transboundary Haze Pollution Act.
events.key_numbers: 7 firms warned by Singapore (16 Oct) · 4 of 7 are suppliers to SGX-listed groups (per Lutfi) · First Resources and Bumitama Agri cited, S$10 bn (about Rp141 T) combined (detik, unit unclear) · Singapore tax 5-15% (Lutfi) · family office minimum US$20 m (Lutfi) · Greenpeace report Oct 2026 (4 of 5 major palm groups had hotspots, per Lutfi)
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia-Singapore blame game over the haze now centres on who really owns the companies behind the fires.
events.spreading_evidence: At least 4 CNN Indonesia/detik/Liputan6/Monitor pieces on 20 Oct; CNBC Indonesia market headline 'Eks Mendag...' same day

events.event: Singapore-listed First Resources disputes that fires started on its Indonesian plantations (SGX statement 15 Oct), Bumitama Agri requests a trading halt, and both shares fall after a Greenpeace report linked them to burning concessions.
events.key_numbers: Greenpeace report 5 Oct 2026 · First Resources -9.1% intraday to S$3.71 (16 Oct) · Bumitama Agri -7.5% to S$1.73 · Bumitama trading halt requested 16 Oct (per CNA via Mothership) · PM Lawrence Wong 15 Oct: investigating, Transboundary Haze Pollution Act (2014) may apply
events.why_it_matters: Shows haze now costs listed palm-oil companies real money, the angle Lutfi's remarks build on.

events.event: State Secretary Prasetyo Hadi says the government is doing cloud seeding with salt and dry ice in several provinces to put out karhutla, with rain reported in Kalimantan districts.
events.key_numbers: Kalbar since 22 Aug: 107 sorties · 98,800 kg salt · Kalteng since 26 Aug: 48 sorties · 43,800 kg salt · Kalsel since 10 Oct: 23 sorties · 23,000 kg salt · Kalsel rainfall 222.67 million m3 · Sumsel since 16 Oct: 8 sorties · 1,600 kg salt · 4,000 dry ice · Lampung 15-18 Oct: 6 sorties · 4,800 dry ice
events.why_it_matters: Shows how the government is trying to end the haze, and how large the effort is.

events.event: Palembang is again covered in thick karhutla smoke with air quality rated hazardous, per a CNN Indonesia photo report.
events.key_numbers: Air quality category: berbahaya (figure not read) · CNN Indonesia 20 Oct 14:26 WIB
events.why_it_matters: Haze is not clearing despite cloud seeding and a fall in national hotspot counts.

events.event: A fire on Gunung Ringgit in the Arjuno-Welirang area, Pasuruan, East Java, burning since 16 Oct, is still spreading and is now about 2-3 km from residents' homes.
events.key_numbers: Started Fri 16 Oct · 2-3 km from homes · area burned not yet surveyed · no casualties reported
events.why_it_matters: East Java mountain fires (after Bromo, where four died) are spreading toward homes.

events.event: University students hold simultaneous demonstrations in Jakarta, Yogyakarta and Makassar on the second anniversary of the Prabowo-Gibran government.
events.key_numbers: 3 cities · 20 Oct 2026 (CNN Indonesia headline 13:29 WIB, article body not opened)
events.why_it_matters: Tests public mood on the government's two-year mark, with karhutla among the demands (per E0152).
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional list; photo of banner protest at Bundaran HI 14:13

events.event: ASDP ferry KMP Batumandi catches fire as it approaches Merak port and passengers are lowered by rope; the cause is under investigation.
events.key_numbers: Cause not yet determined · casualty figures not read (CNBC Indonesia headlines only)
events.why_it_matters: Merak-Bakauheni is a main route for Java-Sumatra travellers and cargo.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia latest list, 4+ headlines within 1 hour on 20 Oct
